name: Faculty of Management Studies, University of Delhi

programs.name: MBA (Full-Time)
programs.feeNote: Information Bulletin 2027-29 states the semester fee is 'currently approximately Rs. 65,075/- per semester'; total = 4 semesters x 65,075 (approximate, payable at the beginning of each academic year, revisable by University of Delhi). Hostel/other charges not included.
programs.intakeNote: Batch 2027-29 sanctioned seats per Information Bulletin (Gen 101, SC 37, ST 19, OBC 69, EWS 25), plus supernumerary seats: PwD 12, CW 12, Foreign Students 25, Ward Teaching 6, Ward Non-Teaching 6, Orphan Quota 2.
programs.placementNote: Official FMS Final Placement Report 2024-26: batch 307, 304 appeared, 287 placed, 3 placement holidays; 119 companies participated; average CTC 32.27 L, median CTC 29.59 L, top-100 average 45.19 L, highest CTC 1.1 Cr. Not stated as externally audited.

selectionProcess.name: Shortlisting on weighted CAT 2026 score
selectionProcess.detail: Weighted score computed from CAT 2026 sectional scores; +5 marks added for women candidates for shortlisting. Applicants without CAT 2026 not considered.

selectionProcess.name: Discussion on Statement of Purpose, Extempore and Personal Interview
selectionProcess.detail: Conducted individually for all shortlisted candidates.

selectionProcess.name: Final selection on composite score
selectionProcess.weightage: Weighted CAT 50%, Class X 10%, Class XII 10%, SOP 10%, Extempore 5%, PI 15%
selectionProcess.detail: Class X/XII: 60% to <75% = 5 marks, 75%+ = 10 marks. +5 marks for women candidates who appear for the interview.

selectionWeightage.note: Batch 2027-29; CAT weighted VARC 40/DILR 30/QA 30; +5 marks for women at shortlisting and final stage.

keyDates.notes: MBA Full-Time 2027-29 (CAT 2026 registration number required). Interviews: 2nd/3rd week of April 2027; result: 3rd/4th week of April 2027. Last date of admission / withdrawal: 31 Aug 2027 (bulletin). Application fee Rs 1000 (Rs 350 SC/ST/PwD).

nirf.note: Not in NIRF 2025 Management ranks 1-100; 101-125 band not checked
